help.title: Help for this page

home: The work waiting for you is at the top, with one button for each job.
Under “Go to”, press a picture to open a page. “More” lists every page.
Press Home at the top at any time to come back here.
Press Me to change the language or make the text bigger.
staff: Type a name in the search box to find a staff member.
Press a staff member to see and change their details.
Use "Add a new staff member" for a step-by-step form.
time: Leave requests waiting for you are shown first.
Attendance today shows who has clocked in.
Public holidays lists this year’s holidays for your state.
Leave balances follow the Employment Act 1955 (sections 60E and 60F), counted from each person’s join date. Public holidays and rest days do not use up leave.
Balances are set on 1 January for the whole year, with no proration in the year someone joins. Company extra days are added on top of the legal minimum.
pay: Run monthly payroll goes step by step. You can stop and come back.
Check the totals before you finalise the month.
Payslips can be printed or saved as PDF.
claims: Attach a photo of the receipt to each claim.
Claims waiting for you are shown first.
Approved claims are paid through payroll. They show on the payslip as a refund and are not counted for EPF, SOCSO, EIS or PCB.
Keep the original receipts for 7 years (Income Tax Act 1967, section 82).
Receipt details are kept so they can be used for LHDN MyInvois e-invoices if your company turns that on.
reports: Pick the month first, then the report.
Every report can be printed or downloaded.
company: Company details holds the name, logo and address.
Departments shows who reports to whom.
Only an Admin can change Settings.
other: Press Back at the top to go to the previous page.
Need a person? Call HR support.

run.undoLose: This cannot be reversed. You will lose:
run.undoLose1_one: The {{month}} payroll run and its {{count}} payslip (total take-home pay {{amount}}).
run.undoLose1_other: The {{month}} payroll run and its {{count}} payslips (total take-home pay {{amount}}).

run.undoYtd: Year-to-date figures are worked out again from the remaining payslips.
run.startAgainBody: You can run this month again from fresh figures, or throw this draft away. Nothing has been paid yet.
run.rerunBody: Every payslip in this draft is worked out again from today's staff, attendance and claims. Changes made with Change are lost.
run.discardBody_one: The draft and its {{count}} payslip are deleted. Nothing has been paid, so no money is affected.
run.discardBody_other: The draft and its {{count}} payslips are deleted. Nothing has been paid, so no money is affected.
run.finalizeBody1_one: This locks {{count}} payslip (total take-home pay {{amount}}). After this you cannot change one person's pay.
run.finalizeBody1_other: This locks {{count}} payslips (total take-home pay {{amount}}). After this you cannot change one person's pay.
run.finalizeBody2: Approved claims in this run are marked paid, and the bank file and the EPF, SOCSO, EIS and PCB files become ready. To change figures later, undo the run and start again.
